metadata.case_name: POON CHUN LAM v. YIP FUNG TEXTILES CO LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

plaintiff.occupation_before: Supervisor at the Defendant’s textile factory
plaintiff.occupation_after: Part-time cleansing worker at a public hospital (Mar-May 2009); employed by a decoration company from June 2009, initially as a cleansing worker up to end 2011 and thereafter as a tiling worker

injuries.description: fracture of the first metatarsal of the Plaintiff’s left foot
source: X-ray revealed a fracture of the first metatarsal of the Plaintiff’s left foot, which Dr. Lam found to be consistent with the mechanism of injury described by the Plaintiff.

manifestations.description: Left foot pain during rainy days and with prolonged standing and walking
Local tenderness in the big toe MTP joint
Mild stiffness in the right big toe at the MTP joint
Mild reduction in work capacity so that he would probably need to take more short breaks during work

treatments_received: Slab for immobilizing the left foot
No physiotherapy (patient elected to do self exercise at home)
Special damages claimed and allowed: Medical expenses $340; Travelling by taxi $290; Tonic Food $5,000; Total special damages $5,630 (receipts produced)

losses.description: Mild residual pain and disability in left foot; pain during rainy days and with prolonged standing and walking; mild reduction in work capacity requiring more short breaks.
